selection.rationale: The accepted cut already includes event_000472 as a buildup shot, but its causal context is unverified. Proposal interval_01:H5 contains two uncovered, non-replay events (event_000467 Pass at 4679.11s and event_000469 Dribble_past at 4691.2s) that immediately precede the existing buildup shot. Selecting these events adds local story footage that supports the existing '蓄力' beat without assuming causality: the pass and dribble are temporally adjacent to the already-accepted shot, and the proposal's own relation is marked as an unverified hypothesis, so no relation is included. Other proposals either rely on replay-flagged events (interval_01:H1), contain events already covered in the accepted cut (interval_01:H5's event_000472), or fall outside the immediate buildup context.
